tyler: Heads-up — CI is failing on the release branch with `vendor-check`. Error shows a submodule SHA drifted but vendor/ wasn't regenerated. Anyone on this? :eyes:

sanjay: I saw the pipeline. Looks like the redwood-protos submodule was bumped by the dependency bot. We need to regenerate vendor and commit the updated lockfile (go.sum / yarn.lock depending on package).

maria: If we regenerate vendor we should run local checks first: `git submodule update --init --recursive` then `./scripts/update-vendor.sh` and finally `make check-vendor` locally. I can take this if we want a single owner.

tyler: Please take it, thanks. Cutoff for dep bumps is tomorrow 2026-03-18 18:00 UTC — no dep or submodule SHA changes after 17:00 UTC unless triaged. :warning:

emily: FYI release manager — we should avoid late submodule pins. If regen touches API protos we might need a tiny changelog note. Can we have a rollback plan if something breaks?

jordan: Quick checklist for whoever does the regen:```bash
# sync submodules
git submodule update --init --recursive
# regenerate vendor (language-specific)
./scripts/update-vendor.sh
# run unit + vendor checks
CI=local make vendor-check
# commit results
git add vendor/ go.sum yarn.lock || true
git commit -m "vendor: regen pre-release (submodule bump)"
```
Also attach the PR to the release milestone and tag `release/rel-v1.8.0`.

sanjay: I'll stand by to help with review and smoke. If there are codegen diffs from protos I'll assist with the small patch.

maria: Taking ownership now. I'll open a WIP PR with regenerated vendor + updated go.sum. I'll mark it WIP until checks pass. Ping @sanjay for review.

deploy-bot: buildkite — triggered: "ci/vendor-check" for branch release/rel-v1.8.0 (pipeline id: 4629).

tyler: Nice. Small reminders: 1) add any user-facing dep changes to the changelog (under Unreleased -> dependencies), 2) avoid touching unrelated files in the commit, 3) if the PR causes >1% test regression we revert and handle in next patch.

maria: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/7891 — includes vendor regen + go.sum update. WIP until CI green. Added changelog note for proto contract bump. @sanjay can you run quick smoke on staging after merge?

sanjay: Will do. ETA ~30m after merge and can validate inference proto compatibility with a couple of sample requests.

tyler: Thanks all — once merged, bump the release-canary and ping this channel. If anything blocks, flag it as release-blocker and we'll triage immediately. :+1:
